correctness.rationale: The empty-edge realization U_empty=I has positive probability; Hilbert-Schmidt variance identity forces every peripheral eigenoperator of the random-unitary channel to have eigenvalue 1 and to commute with each U_A. For tau not in pi Z, each singleton unitary U_e=I+(e^(-2i*tau)-1)L_e/2 generates the same commutant as edge transposition S_e=I-L_e. Connected edge swaps generate S_n, whose matrix commutant is span{P,Q}. Contractivity rules out peripheral Jordan blocks; thus exponential convergence to the trace-preserving projection with conserved tr(P rho). For P3 at tau=k pi singleton unitaries are I and full-path U_full=P-Q for k odd, identity for k even, yielding Phi=(1-r)id+r Ad_(P-Q) and the finite-m exact coherence law. Independent dense-superoperator calculations for p=(0.37,0.42), tau=0.7,pi,2pi and 2000 iterations gave localized probabilities (1/3,1/3,1/3), (5/9,2/9,2/9), (1,0,0) to <4e-13. This is finite diagnostic; proof covers arbitrary finite connected G.
